{{Quote|Welcome, I'm Lando Calrissian. I'm the administrator of this facility.|[[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]], to [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]]|<ref name="Episode 5">{{Film|V}}</ref>}}
An '''administrator''' was any being who was responsible for the management of a particular facility or department within an organization. Administrator could also be used as a formal title for these individuals, with some variations including [[Chief Administrator/Legends|Chief Administrator]] and [[Baron Administrator/Legends|Baron Administrator]].

==Description==
Administrators were individuals tasked with the management of facilities or organizations and ensuring they were run smoothly. They were found in almost all businesses or installations, fulfilling a variety of roles from [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] administration to running individual departments within a corporation.<ref name="CR" />

Lower-level administrators were typically given less responsibility, such as running small outposts in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]], or spaceports on backwater planets. Mid-level administrators were given greater responsibility, such as running vital departments within a business like payroll administration. High-level administrators could be [[Governor/Legends|governors]] of important [[Star system/Legends|star systems]].<ref name="CR" />

Administrator was also used as a formal title for those holding the position. Some administration positions came with their own variation of the title, such as the [[Baron Administrator/Legends|Baron Administrators]] in charge of [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City]],<ref name="SWS">''[[The Star Wars Sourcebook]]''</ref> or [[Chief Administrator/Legends|Chief Administrator]].<ref name="A">[[Allegiance (novel)|''Allegiance'']]</ref>

==Notable administrators==
[[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]], a [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] and [[Gambler/Legends|gambler]], won control of the [[Mining/Legends|mining]] colony [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City]] in a [[Sabacc/Legends|sabacc]] tournament. He was appointed as [[Baron Administrator/Legends|Baron Administrator]],<ref name="HTTESB">''[[Heir to the Empire Sourcebook]]''</ref> replacing [[Dominic Raynor]].<ref name="GG2">''[[Galaxy Guide 2: Yavin and Bespin]]''</ref>

In [[3951 BBY]], Administrator [[Terena Adare]] was in charge of the settlement of [[Khoonda]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]]. Adare had previously served as the planet's Agricultural Administrator prior to [[Darth Malak]]'s [[Attack on Dantooine (Jedi Civil War)|assault]] on the world.<ref name="KOTOR2">''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic II: The Sith Lords]]''</ref> [[Elexia Nis'tar]] was appointed administrator of the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Haven (city)|Haven]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Iol]] during the last [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].<ref name="TUR">''[[The Unknown Regions]]''</ref>

Following a successful career as a [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] in both the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Republic]] and [[Imperial Senate/Legends|Imperial Senates]], [[Simon Greyshade/Legends|Simon Greyshade]] served as administrator of [[The Wheel/Legends|The Wheel]].<ref name="SW18">[[Star Wars (1977) 18|''Star Wars'' (1977) 18]]</ref> [[Pira Leemad]] was the Chief Administrator of the [[Lant Mining Corporation]], a [[Megacorporation/Legends|megacorporation]] operating in the [[Brak sector/Legends|Brak sector]].<ref name="FBS">''[[Flashpoint! Brak Sector]]''</ref> [[Kilon Tarlok]] administered [[Terman Station]] in the [[Tharin sector/Legends|Tharin sector]]. Tarlok was unaware that his salary was paid for by [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]].<ref name="SSR">''[[Secrets of the Sisar Run]]''</ref>

During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Guldus Bemm]] became the administrator of the [[Canyon Mining Facility]]. A former [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]], Bemm attempted to lure [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] into a trap with the intention of delivering him to [[Imperial Advisor/Legends|Imperial Advisor]] [[Bregius Golthan]].<ref name="BCB">{{JournalCite|8|Black Curs Blues}}</ref> [[Lenc]] served as the administrator of a brutal [[Mining/Legends|mining]] colony on [[Weldii III]].<ref name="UB">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/article/unfinished1|text=Unfinished Business, Part 1: Gunrunner|int=Unfinished Business (scenario)}}</ref>

[[Hekis Durumm Perdo Kolokk Baldikarr Thun]] was the manufacturing administrator on the [[Droid/Legends|droid]] manufacturing world of [[Mechis III/Legends|Mechis III]]. Thun was killed by his droid, [[3D-4X]], as part of [[IG-88A/Legends|IG-88's]] [[Mechis III Uprising|plan]] to take over the planet and begin a [[Droid Revolution|droid revolution]].<ref name="TIA">{{StoryCite|story=Therefore I Am: The Tale of IG-88|book=Tales of the Bounty Hunters}}</ref>
